subject: Oakridge Retail - Resale Certificate: EIN mismatch & multi-entity coverage
messages:
From: Eric Sweeney <eric.sweeney@oakridge-retail.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Resale certificate for Redwood invoices (ATTACHMENTS)

Hi Jasmine —

Attached are Oakridge's signed resale certificate and a W-9 for the account. We recently merged a small distributor into our parent and the reseller cert covers multiple DBAs; I attached the signed PDF and the W-9 as requested on the intake form.

Files attached:
- Oakridge_Resale_Cert_signed.pdf (signed resale certificate, multi-DBA page included)
- Oakridge_W9.pdf

Let me know if you need an original stamped copy or a different format. We're trying to get invoice INV-2026-0789 released; our AP team flagged the hold and asked me to follow up.

Thanks,
Eric Sweeney
Director, Tax & Treasury
Oakridge Retail

---

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Eric Sweeney <eric.sweeney@oakridge-retail.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 10:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Resale certificate for Redwood invoices (ATTACHMENTS)

Hi Eric —

Thanks for the upload and the quick turnaround. Appreciate the W-9 too. Quick status and a couple of gaps we need to clear before we can remove the invoice hold: 

1) EIN on the resale cert (page 1) does not match the EIN on the W-9. Our tax intake requires the EIN to match the signed cert for state validation. If the resale cert is for a DBA under the same EIN, please confirm that explicitly and add the parent entity name.
2) Several states require either a seller's permit or an explicit multi-entity blanket statement; the form you sent has the DBAs listed but no affirmative language about blanket coverage.

Can you: 1) resend a corrected resale cert with the parent EIN / signature page adjusted OR 2) provide a short attestation email on company letterhead confirming that the DBAs listed are covered under the EIN on the W-9? Either is fine.

I've attached our acceptance checklist to show the exact fields the tax team validates. If you prefer, we can accept a DocuSign envelope with corrected fields.

Attachment: redwood_resale_acceptance_criteria.pdf (checklist)

If you can get this over today we'll try to clear the hold before the end of the week.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Sr. Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

---

From: Eric Sweeney <eric.sweeney@oakridge-retail.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Cc: accounts-payable@oakridge-retail.com
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Resale certificate for Redwood invoices (ATTACHMENTS)

Thanks Jasmine —

Apologies, that was my oversight. I've gone back to legal and attached a corrected certificate with the parent EIN included and an explicit line that reads: "This certificate applies as a blanket resale certificate covering the listed DBAs under parent entity Oakridge Retail, EIN 12-3456789."

Please see Oakridge_Cert_signed_corrected.pdf attached. I can also provide a signed attestation letter on letterhead if that helps.

Eric

Attachments:
- Oakridge_Cert_signed_corrected.pdf
